title: Instalments Left to the Presentation the Schedule Will Make Again on a Granite Ridge Pass Account
content:
Where a refusal on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account is recent enough that the schedule will present the same instalment again, some or all of the instalments still to be settled are left to that presentation rather than taken at the desk.

**First.** Where the most recent refusal standing on the pass account was recorded fewer days ago than the retry interval the tier carries and the pass record still admits the holder, every instalment still to be settled is left to that presentation.

**Second.** Where the most recent refusal standing on the pass account was recorded fewer days ago than the retry interval the tier carries and the pass record no longer admits the holder, 1 instalment is left to it.

**Otherwise.** In any other case nothing is left to that presentation by this rule.

### The two conditions read together

| Days since the most recent refusal, against the tier's retry interval | The pass record | Instalments left to the presentation the schedule will make again |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer than the retry interval | still admits the holder | every instalment still to be settled |
| fewer than the retry interval | no longer admits the holder | 1 |
| the retry interval or more | either | none by this rule |

### Worked on hypothetical figures

A Granite Ridge Summit Pass carries a retry interval of 5 calendar days. The most recent refusal standing was recorded 3 days before the handling date, and 3 instalments are still to be settled.

Where the pass record still admits the holder, all 3 are left to the presentation the schedule will make again. Where the record no longer admits the holder, 1 is left to it and 2 remain to be taken at the desk. Had the most recent refusal been recorded 5 or more days before the handling date, this rule would leave nothing to that presentation in either case.
